name: Sutter Eden Medical Center Auxiliary Volunteer (16 and up)
org: Sutter Health, Eden Medical Center Auxiliary
city: Castro Valley, CA (20103 Lake Chabot Road)
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors at the hospital Information Desk or in the Gift Shop. Many different shifts are open.
who_can_apply: Volunteers 16 years and older. No school or residency rule is stated.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The listing said Actively recruiting on 2026-10-16.
how_to_apply: Call the hospital's volunteer office at 510-727-3080. Ask how to apply.
notes: Read on the Sutter Health page on 2026-10-16. The page also names a family support role in the ER. But Sutter's own listing for that role says 18 and up. So teens should expect the front desk or the gift shop. The page does not list hours, how long you must stay, a health check, a TB test or fees. Ask the volunteer office.
